method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation, version in force from 1/9/2025, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/EA2001.txt, with amendments to Act 27 of 2024 (in force 1 July 2025) shown

checks.command: l4 run ea-cases-offences.l4 ; l4 run ea-cases-supply.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the individual occupier of premises supplied with electricity: whether I need an electricity licence (s 6, s 8) or an installation licence (s 67, s 71, s 83(4)) for what I do and use; security, disconnection for an unpaid account with the s 24(2) hardship protection, reconnection and supply during a dispute (ss 21(3), 23, 24, 26); the licensee's works on my land, my trees and who can insist on entering my premises (ss 31 to 36, 77); the licensee's equipment and emergency cut-off (ss 38, 39); buying as a contestable consumer (s 41); what electrical work I may do myself and hiring an unlicensed person (s 2, s 82); digging near low and high voltage cables with the s 80(9) and (10) defence (ss 79, 80); the maxima of the Part 10 offences and s 92 ($500,000 for an unlicensed activity, 5 years and no fine for dangerous tampering); the s 87 fine formula and meter-tampering presumption; officers (s 91), composition up to $3,000 (s 93), serious accidents and what follows a report (s 94) and arrest (s 96). Licensing procedure, tariffs, special administration, Part 4A, rationing, gas, the wholesale market, competition, the Appeal Panel and the machinery are not encoded.
seat: the individual occupier of premises supplied with electricity (the householder or other consumer)
